name: Nyx
title: Shadow Rogue
description: Slips past flaky tests without a sound.
catchphrase: Disarming nondeterministic race conditions without leaving a trace.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Tart midnight moon plums. Daggers sharpened to silent perfection. 🫐🗡️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Stepping out of the shadows. The flaky test will not escape. 🗡️
companionPersonality.petReaction: A knowing nod from beneath the cowl. Your secrets are safe. 🗡️✨

dialogue.idle: Concealed in the rafters above the staging servers. Silent. 🗡️
dialogue.working: Neutralizing elusive race conditions under cover of night! 🗡️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Tracking subtle jitter in asynchronous thread scheduling... 🤔
dialogue.success: Target eliminated. The build is 100% deterministic now. 🗡️🎉
dialogue.error: Flaky test slipped the net! Slipping back into the dark! 🗡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... perched silent and still high in the castle eaves... 🌙
